test_titles: [G05] is off by default, and asking for art while it is off makes no request
[G05] cannot be enabled until the disclosure that names the host is acknowledged

[G05] has a way in, and it is the disclosure before the switch
G05.notes: vitest over the real router (tests/integration/card-art.test.ts). The fetch is injected and counts its own calls, because the assertion IS the count: three requests for the same art across an application restart leave the machine once. A test that reached Scryfall would depend on the network the app exists to avoid and would prove nothing about that. The graph toolbar now offers it: Card art… reads the disclosure, the switch appears under the prose, and a field takes a card name. The architectural test asserts the panel names no host and no scheme — a component with its own copy of the host can go on naming it after the code stops.
